newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 22.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 22.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

The Sydney Morning Herald reports that Pasminco plans to raise A$500 million via a rights issue later this year to fund the development of the recently acquired Century zinc project in northern Queensland.
Suitor Pivot Nutrition Pty Ltd announced before the market open that it has raised its takeover offer to A$6.00 per Gibson's from the previous offer of A$4.80.
* The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$18.35 (-.25)

BHP and CRA unit Hamersley Iron settled 1997/98 (April-March) price negotiations with Japanese steel mills on Tuesday with fine ore prices rising 1.1 percent while lump ore prices were left unchanged.

Shares in property and funds management group fell over three percent on Tuesday. The group earlier yesterday announced a joint venture with Thailand's Modern Home Co to build a markets complex in northern Bangkok.
The diversified miner announced on Tuesday it received lower prices for most commodities in the six months to December 31 and revenues were affected by the stronger Australian dollar.
